> 🚨 This repository is for fleet-telemetry. If you are not requesting a change to the code in this repository, please instead submit a support request by clicking the Support Inquiry link from within the developer dashboard: https://developer.tesla.com/dashboard

### New streamable field requests

Field enum IDs are assigned by Tesla with firmware. Do **not** open a PR that invents the next ID. Describe the signals (names, units, source) and wait for an official ID — see README “Field availability and new field requests” and [#429](https://github.com/teslamotors/fleet-telemetry/issues/429) (CAC) as an example.
